Which command builds your package?: What two files does uv build produce?
uv build: A source distribution (.tar.gz) and a wheel (.whl), both in dist/.

Which command builds your package?: Which is built from which?
uv build: The wheel is built from the source distribution. uv build's own output says so.

Which command builds your package?: What is a source distribution?
uv build: Your code, packed up. Whoever installs it has to build the package on their own machine.

Which command builds your package?: What is a wheel?
uv build: The built result, ready to unpack straight into site-packages, which is why installing from one is nearly instant.

Which command builds your package?: Read the filename invoice_app-0.1.0-py3-none-any.whl
uv build: Package invoice_app, version 0.1.0, any Python 3, no C extensions, any platform.

Which command builds your package?: What is a wheel file, structurally?
uv build: A zip archive containing the package folder and a dist-info folder of metadata.

Which command builds your package?: What does uv build --no-sources do?
uv build: Resolves as a stranger would, so a local path or git branch cannot escape into the published package.

Which command builds your package?: Why does --no-sources matter?
uv build: Nobody else has your folder. A pointer that works only on your machine must not travel.

Which command builds your package?: Which command shows the current version?
uv build: uv version

Which command builds your package?: How do you increase the version?
uv build: uv version --bump major, minor, or patch.

Which command builds your package?: What does --dry-run add?
uv build: Prints the change as an arrow and writes nothing, so you can check before committing to it.

Which command builds your package?: What does a patch bump promise?
uv build: A fix that breaks nothing.

Which command builds your package?: What does a minor bump promise?
uv build: Something new, with everything that already worked still working.

Which command builds your package?: What does a major bump promise?
uv build: Something was deliberately broken, and everyone depending on you must read the notes.

Which command builds your package?: Which command uploads your package?
uv build: uv publish

Which command builds your package?: Where should a publish token live?
uv build: In an environment variable such as UV_PUBLISH_TOKEN — never in a command, a file, or on screen.

Which command builds your package?: What is TestPyPI for?
uv build: Rehearsing a publish on a separate index where a mistake costs nothing.

Which command builds your package?: What is trusted publishing?
uv build: Your CI provider proves its identity directly to the index, so no token is created, stored or rotated.

Which command builds your package?: Can you re-upload a published version with different contents?
uv build: No. A published version is permanent. The only fix is to publish a new version.

uv build: uv run --with <package> --no-project -- python -c "import <package>", which proves it works from nothing.
